items.summary: Apiweiser, is a CLI tool that will manage the dependency upgrades of your repositories. This is designed for developers and teams which struggle to keep the dependencies up to date regardless of security patches or API depreciation. It is AI-native by default where each changelog is interpreted by an AI agent and the code changes in the repository are done by a deterministic codemod generated by you local coding agent.
